annotations.title: Show channel QR and secure setup

description: Use when a confirmed channel.begin receipt or fresh channel status reports a pending attempt with attemptId, or when the user asks to resume that attempt. Opens its private WhatsApp/Telegram QR, Instagram/Facebook authorization or secure Telegram bot setup. This is the visual setup step; do not repeat channel.begin to display it. Show setupUrl if the host cannot render the card; the owner signs in there. Pairing secrets stay outside the conversation.
name: beautyos_channel_setup_link
